welcome:
👋 Hi, {name}!

I'm a smart assistant powered by ChatGPT. Just ask me anything.

✨ What I can do:
• Answer questions and hold meaningful conversations
• Generate images from a prompt (/image)
• Transcribe voice messages
• Work in different "roles" (/role)

Free today: {messages} messages, {images} image, {voices} voices.
All commands: /help
welcome_bonus: 🎁 You were invited by a friend — get +{messages} bonus messages and +{images} images!
help: 📖 Commands /start — welcome and referral link /help — this help /menu — main menu /new — clear chat context /role — pick assistant role /model — pick GPT model /image — generate an image /profile — your profile and limits /buy — buy subscription /ref — referral program /lang — change language 💬 Just send a message — I'll reply. You can also send a voice message — I'll transcribe and answer.
limit_reached_messages:
⛔ Daily message limit reached.
Buy a subscription or invite friends to get more.
limit_reached_images:
⛔ Daily image limit reached.
Buy a subscription for more.
limit_reached_voices:
⛔ Daily voice limit reached.
Buy a subscription for more.
image_prompt: Describe the image you want. Example: An astronaut playing guitar on Mars, cinematic lighting
image_too_short: Prompt is too short. Please send a more detailed one.
openai_error:
⚠️ Could not get a response from the AI: {error}
Try again in a minute.
pay_yookassa_created: 💳 Invoice created Tap the button below to pay. After payment, come back and press "Check payment".
pay_success: 🎉 Payment received! Subscription "{tariff}" is active until {until}.
pay_not_found: Payment is not confirmed yet. Try again later.
pay_yookassa_disabled: Card payments are not available. Use Telegram Stars.
referral_info: 👥 Referral program For every friend who joins through your link you get +{bonus_m} bonus messages and +{bonus_i} images. Your link: {link} Invited: {count}
referral_reward: 🎁 Your friend joined! +{bonus_m} messages and +{bonus_i} images added.
blocked: 🚫 Your account is blocked. Contact admin.
admin_broadcast_prompt: Send a message to broadcast. /cancel to abort.
admin_broadcast_confirm: Broadcast to {count} users? /confirm to send, /cancel to abort.
